reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs with no comment — consistent with a compliant, evidence-only finding where no negotiation issue is raised.

The cited text supports the conclusion: Art. 9 imposes only mutual record-keeping/retention duties on 'Each Party' with no examination or inspection right; Sections 3.6.1–3.6.2 are each Party's quality oversight of its own Permitted Third Parties / PB's own manufacturing facilities with report copies shared, i.e. self-audit and reporting rather than an SFJ audit right over PB.

No unlimited/unannounced audit or remote system-access language appears in the cited clauses, so nothing reaches walk-away territory; the absence of any audit right binding our client is more favourable than the preferred position and correctly left unredlined (inserting limits would create a right SFJ does not have).

The failed 'audit frequency limited' deterministic check is a false signal here — the regex cannot match frequency caps because there is no audit right against us to cap; it does not undermine the substance.

Rationale appropriately notes for the file the terms to demand (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, independent auditor, Vendor cost unless >5% underpayment, no system access) if SFJ later seeks a records-audit right.
